senses.gloss: m. pl. (פָּצַע, with format, ל) burst fruits, fruits that fell off in an unripe state and were placed in the sun to ripen.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 45b:1">Sabb. 45ᵇ</cite> top <he>פַּצְעִילֵי תמרה</he> dates lying on the roof to ripen; <cite ref="Beitzah 40a:17">Bets. 40ᵃ</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="Q00792"><he>פִּיצּוּלַיָּא</he></cite>.
